change_summary: The required dawn+20 owner-camera cycle supplied matching 6/6 three-frame bursts with usable light and no scoped Jubilee-type signal. Both permitted public live players showed advancing LIVE windows and no event evidence in their visible broad areas. The tide was falling toward an 08:53 CDT low and NGOFS2 guidance was seaward across the 1-12 hour forward windows. Critical local bottom/contact-strip oxygen remains unknown, so uncertainty is retained rather than guessed.
